title: Admin
intro: Platform administration. Every action here is recorded in the audit log.

overview.pendingListings: {count, plural, =0 {No services waiting} one {# service waiting for review} other {# services waiting for review}}

moderation.title: Moderation queue
moderation.intro: New and edited profiles and services, oldest first. Rejections must include a statement of reasons; the expert sees it.

flags.title: Automatic flags
flags.prompt_injection: Possible prompt injection aimed at AI Discovery

detail.title: Review
detail.notPending: This request has already been decided.
detail.openPublic: Open the page as the expert sees it
detail.reasonHint: Required to reject (at least 10 characters). Explain what must change; the expert will see this text.
detail.editNote: This service is live. Approving marks the change as checked; rejecting takes the service offline until the expert fixes it.

catalog.title: Live content
catalog.intro: Find experts and services to suspend or reinstate. Suspensions need a statement of reasons.
catalog.reasonHint: Shown to the expert. At least 10 characters.

categories.title: Categories
categories.intro: The category tree clients browse. Deactivating a category hides it and its subcategories from navigation and new services.

fields.slugHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens. Changing it changes the page address.
fields.name: Name
fields.iconKeyHint: A Lucide icon name, for example "bot".

reassign.title: Move services
reassign.description: Move every service whose main category is this one to another active category.
reassign.done: {count, plural, =0 {No services to move} one {# service moved} other {# services moved}}

taxonomy.title: Taxonomy
taxonomy.intro: Skills, technologies and industries used in profiles, services and search. Synonyms make search find the right term.
taxonomy.mergeHint: Moves every use to the chosen term and keeps this name as a synonym.

fields.name: Name
fields.aliasesHint: Separate with commas, for example "chatbot, chat bot, bot development".

errors.mfa: Staff actions need two-step verification and the right staff role.

reports.title: Reports
reports.intro: Reports from users and automatic flags (contact details, off-platform payment). Viewing a reported conversation is recorded in the audit log.
reports.targetMissing: The reported item no longer exists.
reports.conversationNote: Shown to moderators only for this report. This view is audited.

resolve.title: Close the report
resolve.noteHint: Optional. Not shown to the reporter.

message.reasonHint: Required to remove (10+ characters). The sender is notified with this text.

project.reasonHint: Required to remove (10+ characters). The client is notified with this text.
